title: US-Iran Military Conflict Escalates: Strikes on Bushehr Nuclear Plant Perimeter, Strait of Hormuz in Focus
summary: The United States launched multiple airstrikes against Iran, with one strike reported to have targeted the perimeter of the Bushehr Nuclear Power Plant, according to Iranian officials. Iran retaliated by claiming hits on US military targets in the Gulf. Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei was killed and buried in Mashhad with large crowds in attendance. The Strait of Hormuz, a critical global oil chokepoint, is at the centre of the escalating dispute, with Israel also threatening to strike Iran 'with greater force.'
exam_angle: The Strait of Hormuz carries approximately 20% of global oil trade; its closure or disruption has major implications for India's energy security and global oil prices. The Bushehr Nuclear Plant and Iran's nuclear programme are perennial UPSC topics under international relations and non-proliferation.
key_facts: US strikes targeted Bushehr Nuclear Plant perimeter in Iran
Iran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei killed; buried in Mashhad
Strait of Hormuz is at the centre of the US-Iran dispute
Israel threatened to attack Iran 'with greater force'

title: PM Modi Concludes Australia Visit: 18 Outcomes Including Uranium Deal, AUD 500 Million Investment, Early Trade Pact
summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi concluded his state visit to Australia with 18 announced outcomes spanning defence, nuclear energy, trade, and clean energy cooperation. Key deliverables include an India-Australia uranium deal, an AUD 500 million investment commitment, and progress towards an early harvest trade pact. Modi addressed the Indian diaspora in Melbourne, highlighting Operation Sindoor, Make in India, and India's global humanitarian role. Australia's former PM Scott Morrison also called for strengthening the 'Indo' dimension of the Indo-Pacific agenda.
exam_angle: India-Australia Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and the Comprehensive Economic Cooperation Agreement (CECA) are key bilateral frameworks; uranium cooperation links to India's civil nuclear programme under the Indo-Australian Nuclear Cooperation Agreement.
key_facts: 18 outcomes announced during PM Modi's Australia visit
India-Australia uranium deal signed
AUD 500 million investment commitment made
Early harvest trade pact discussions advanced

title: India-New Zealand FTA: '57% Tariff-Free from Day One', New Zealand PM Hails Pact
summary: New Zealand Prime Minister praised the newly concluded India-New Zealand Free Trade Agreement, stating that 57% of trade would be tariff-free from the first day of implementation. The deal marks a significant step in India's bilateral trade expansion in the Indo-Pacific region. This development comes alongside India's broader push for trade agreements with Australia and ongoing US tariff negotiations.
exam_angle: India's FTA strategy in the Indo-Pacific is a key theme under GS Paper 2 (IR) and GS Paper 3 (Economy); aspirants should note the tariff liberalisation percentage and the pattern of India's trade diplomacy.
key_facts: India-New Zealand FTA announced
57% of trade tariff-free from day one
Part of India's broader Indo-Pacific trade diplomacy
New Zealand PM hailed the agreement

title: India Flags Inconsistencies in US Section 301 Forced Labour Law; India Inc Urges USTR to Drop Tariff Plans
summary: India formally flagged inconsistencies in the US application of Section 301 of the Trade Act regarding forced labour, pointing to selective exemptions that disadvantage Indian exporters. Simultaneously, Indian industry bodies urged the US Trade Representative (USTR) to drop proposed tariff increases on Indian goods. These developments reflect ongoing India-US trade tensions ahead of a potential bilateral trade deal.
exam_angle: Section 301 of the US Trade Act allows unilateral tariffs on countries deemed to engage in unfair trade practices; India-US trade negotiations and tariff disputes are high-priority topics for GS Paper 2 and GS Paper 3.
key_facts: India flagged US Section 301 forced labour law as selectively applied
India Inc urged USTR to drop tariff plan on Indian goods
US Section 301 allows unilateral tariffs on unfair trade practices
Issue is part of ongoing India-US bilateral trade negotiations

title: Government Clears Vivo-Dixon Joint Venture Under Press Note 3 FDI Framework
summary: The Indian government approved the Vivo-Dixon joint venture for domestic smartphone manufacturing under the revised Press Note 3 norms, which govern FDI from countries sharing a land border with India. This is a significant development as it signals an easing of the Press Note 3 framework to encourage Chinese-linked investment in domestic manufacturing. Dixon Technologies, an Indian electronics manufacturer, is the local partner in the JV.
exam_angle: Press Note 3 (2020) mandates government approval for FDI from land-border-sharing countries (including China); this case tests the balance between FDI liberalisation, Make in India, and national security screening.
key_facts: Vivo-Dixon JV approved under Press Note 3 FDI norms
Press Note 3 (2020) requires govt approval for FDI from land-border nations including China
Dixon Technologies is the Indian partner in the JV
JV aimed at domestic smartphone manufacturing under Make in India

title: India's US Treasury Holdings Fall to Near 6-Year Low; RBI Shifts Towards Gold
summary: India's holdings of US Treasury securities have fallen to a near six-year low, indicating a strategic shift by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) away from dollar-denominated assets. Analysts point to a deliberate move towards gold and diversification of foreign exchange reserves. This shift reflects broader global de-dollarisation trends and India's hedging strategy amid geopolitical uncertainties.
exam_angle: RBI's foreign exchange reserve management, de-dollarisation trends, and India's gold reserve strategy are important topics for GS Paper 3 (Economy); links to concepts of currency risk and reserve diversification.
key_facts: India's US Treasury holdings at near 6-year low
RBI is diversifying reserves towards gold
Reflects global de-dollarisation trends
India's forex reserve management strategy is evolving

title: ADB Cuts India's FY27 GDP Growth Forecast
summary: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) has revised downward India's growth forecast for FY2026-27, citing headwinds including global trade uncertainty, US tariff impacts, and domestic demand moderation. This is part of a broader trend of multilateral institutions adjusting India's growth outlook amid geopolitical and economic volatility.
exam_angle: ADB's India growth forecasts are frequently cited in UPSC prelims and mains; aspirants must track revisions by multilateral agencies (ADB, IMF, World Bank) and the reasons cited for changes.
key_facts: ADB cut India's FY27 GDP growth forecast
Reasons include global trade uncertainty and US tariff impacts
ADB is a Manila-based multilateral development bank
India is the largest borrower from ADB

title: TCS Q1 FY27 Results: Net Profit Rises 4.61% to Rs 13,349 Crore; BFSI Segment Leads
summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) reported a net profit of Rs 13,349 crore for Q1 FY2026-27, a 4.61% year-on-year increase. The Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI) segment led revenue growth. Wage hikes impacted operating margins by 170 basis points. TCS also announced multiple AI transformation deals, signalling the growing role of artificial intelligence in the IT sector.
exam_angle: TCS quarterly results are a bellwether for India's IT sector and foreign exchange earnings; the AI-driven transformation of the IT sector and its impact on employment are key GS Paper 3 themes.
key_facts: TCS Q1 FY27 net profit: Rs 13,349 crore (up 4.61% YoY)
BFSI segment led growth

title: US Holds Off New Tariffs on Commercial Aircraft Imports
summary: The United States has decided to hold off on imposing new tariffs on commercial aircraft imports, providing relief to global aviation and aerospace supply chains. This decision has implications for Boeing's international sales and for countries like India that are major buyers of commercial aircraft.
exam_angle: US tariff policy on aircraft affects India's aviation sector (Air India, IndiGo fleet purchases) and is relevant to GS Paper 3 (Economy) and GS Paper 2 (IR) under trade policy.

title: Operation Hardball: FBI Unravels Lawrence Bishnoi Gang; Indian Agencies Collaborate
summary: A joint operation codenamed 'Operation Hardball' saw Indian security agencies share and verify lists of names and hideouts with the FBI, leading to the unravelling of the Lawrence Bishnoi criminal syndicate operating from the US and Canada. US DoJ documents reveal Bishnoi ran a decentralised criminal network and allegedly sought to kill a target identified as 'S.K.' to instil fear. Separately, a chargesheet revealed that slain Khalistani terrorist Hardeep Singh Nijjar had persuaded gangster Arsh Dalla to flee to Canada.
exam_angle: Cross-border organised crime and India-US law enforcement cooperation are key themes; the Bishnoi gang's international operations link to issues of diaspora radicalisation, Khalistan, and extradition frameworks discussed in GS Paper 2 (IR) and GS Paper 3 (Internal Security).
key_facts: Operation Hardball: Indian agencies collaborated with FBI to target Bishnoi-Brar network
US DoJ: Bishnoi ran a decentralised syndicate from abroad
Nijjar persuaded gangster Arsh Dalla to flee to Canada (per chargesheet)
Operation involved undercover agents and informants

title: US to Supply Tomahawk Missiles to Germany: Chancellor Friedrich Merz
summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz announced that the United States will supply Tomahawk cruise missiles to Germany, marking a significant upgrade in Germany's long-range strike capability within NATO. This development comes amid heightened European defence spending following the Russia-Ukraine conflict and signals deepening US-Germany defence ties.
exam_angle: NATO's evolving defence posture, Germany's rearmament, and Tomahawk missile capabilities are relevant to GS Paper 2 (IR) under European security architecture and international alliances.

summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah announced that India will build 'smart borders' integrating advanced surveillance technology to strengthen the national security grid against cross-border infiltration. The initiative is aimed at countering threats from Pakistan and Bangladesh borders and will involve AI-based surveillance systems.

summary: The Digital India BHASHINI Division (DIBD) signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the National Forensic Sciences University (NFSU) to advance multilingual Artificial Intelligence and Indian language technologies. title: BSE Completes 151 Years: Asia's Oldest Stock Exchange Milestones
summary: The Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE), established in 1875, completed 151 years of operation, making it Asia's oldest stock exchange. BSE has been a central institution in India's capital market development, now hosting over 5,000 listed companies and serving as a benchmark for Indian equity markets.

title: Supreme Court: Failure to Report Child Sexual Abuse Invites POCSO Action
summary: The Supreme Court of India ruled that failure to report child sexual abuse cases attracts prosecution under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act. The ruling reinforces the mandatory reporting obligation under Section 19 of POCSO, which requires any person aware of child sexual abuse to report it to the police or special court.
exam_angle: POCSO Act (2012) and its mandatory reporting provisions are important for GS Paper 2 (Polity/Governance) and GS Paper 1 (Social Issues); Supreme Court interpretations of POCSO are high-value exam topics.
key_facts: SC ruled failure to report child sexual abuse attracts POCSO prosecution
Section 19 of POCSO mandates reporting of child sexual abuse
POCSO Act enacted in 2012
Ruling strengthens mandatory reporting obligation for all persons

summary: Union Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia addressed the Destination Tripura Business Conclave 2026, inviting investors to explore Tripura's growth potential in sectors including connectivity, tourism, and industry. Tripura, a landlocked northeastern state, has been promoted as a gateway to Southeast Asia under India's Act East Policy and the BIMSTEC framework.
exam_angle: Tripura's strategic position under India's Act East Policy, BIMSTEC connectivity, and investment conclave frameworks are relevant to GS Paper 2 (IR) and GS Paper 3 (Economy/Infrastructure).

title: Trump Claims 11 Jets Downed During India-Pakistan Hostilities
summary: US President Donald Trump claimed that 11 jets were downed during recent India-Pakistan military hostilities (Operation Sindoor period), without specifying the breakdown by country. The statement, made publicly, adds to international commentary on the aerial conflict dimensions of Operation Sindoor. India had not officially confirmed the specific number.
exam_angle: Operation Sindoor and its diplomatic and military dimensions are highly exam-relevant for GS Paper 2 (IR) and GS Paper 3 (Internal Security/Defence); Trump's statements reflect the international dimensions of the India-Pakistan conflict.
